verdict.rationale: Lago documents its own self-hosted deployment (via Docker), so a user can run it on infrastructure of their choosing and decide where billing data lives. The evidence never addresses region selection or data-residency guarantees for the managed cloud offering. Missing for 10: documented cloud region/residency selection, explicit data-residency or compliance documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Docker is the easiest way to get started with the self-hosted version of Lago.
a self-hosted option fits our culture and philosophy a lot better
